name: opencode-db-insight
description: OpenCode V2 plugin: historical usage dashboard, session replay and markdown export from the local opencode database

scripts.check: npm run check:types && npx esbuild src/index.ts && npx esbuild src/tui.tsx --loader:.tsx=tsx --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=@opentui/solid --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:solid-js --external:@opentui/* --outfile=tmp-check.js && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('tmp-check.js','utf8'); if(s.includes('react/jsx-runtime')) { console.error('check: TUI bundle resolved React JSX runtime instead of @opentui/solid'); process.exit(1) } if(!s.includes('@opentui/solid/jsx-runtime')) { console.error('check: TUI bundle is missing the @opentui/solid jsx-runtime reference'); process.exit(1) }" && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('tmp-check.js')"
